textRuns.value: Limitations. Counts are FDA-recorded recall events with no production denominator, so they are not failure rates. FDA classification and enforcement priorities shape what is recorded. Categories come from keyword rules (~0.90 precision; Unclassified shown). USDA-FSIS meat/poultry recalls are excluded. Generic, hypothesis-level QA actions inferred from category-level patterns in public openFDA recall (enforcement) data. Not findings about any named firm, not regulatory or legal advice, and not a substitute for a site's own risk assessment. Built from openFDA data - not for clinical or regulatory decisions.
